PEOPLE / FOUNDER, INVENTOR, AND TEACHER

Don Laubach

The October 1986 newspaper reporting follows Laubach’s Cow Talk development. The July 1998 company biographical sheet identifies him as founder and president, inventor, author, and teacher.

Dated newspaper coverage and company biographical record.

October 10, 1986

Cow Call Draws Elk Like Crazy

Mark Henckel’s newspaper account follows Don Laubach, the Cow Talk call, and the early business in Gardiner, Montana. It names Laubach and Eastman in the formation of E.L.K., Inc.

March 24, 1988

Montana Outdoor Recreation Exposition

A dated exposition advertisement schedules Don Laubach’s elk-calling presentations at the March 25–27, 1988 show in Billings. The accompanying profile connects calling, books, and video.

July 30, 1998

Don Laubach: Company Biographical Sheet

A company biographical sheet records Laubach’s calls, books with Mark Henckel, and video work with Gordon Eastman. Handwritten notes plan a store seminar and call demonstrations.
